name: upload-media-client
description: Framework-agnostic chunk and direct file upload client library
author: Victor Ajadi

scripts.build:main: tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --splitting false --out-dir dist --external @ffmpeg/ffmpeg --external @ffmpeg/util --external @ffmpeg/core --platform browser --target es2020
scripts.build:react: tsup src/react/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --splitting false --out-dir dist/react --external react --external react-dom --external zustand --external @ffmpeg/ffmpeg --external @ffmpeg/util --external @ffmpeg/core --platform browser --target es2020
scripts.build:worker: tsup src/worker/upload.worker.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --splitting false --out-dir dist/worker --external @ffmpeg/ffmpeg --external @ffmpeg/util --external @ffmpeg/core --platform browser --target es2020
scripts.dev:main: tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --watch --splitting false --out-dir dist --external @ffmpeg/ffmpeg --external @ffmpeg/util --external @ffmpeg/core --platform browser
scripts.dev:react: tsup src/react/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --watch --splitting false --out-dir dist/react --external react --external react-dom --external zustand --external @ffmpeg/ffmpeg --external @ffmpeg/util --external @ffmpeg/core --platform browser
scripts.dev:worker: tsup src/worker/upload.worker.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --watch --splitting false --out-dir dist/worker --external @ffmpeg/ffmpeg --external @ffmpeg/util --external @ffmpeg/core --platform browser
